Dense surface — BLAZING deep glossy dark-chocolate brown across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID creamy white-chocolate drizzle lines and tiny gold-leaf flecks across the surface, with thin glossy drizzle lines tracing every curve of her body, mirror-glossy tempered, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Background: a bright minimalist loft studio with pale concrete floors, tall factory windows, a standard door and a row of standard-height steps, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
